name: desktop-march-7th
description: A lightweight March 7th desktop companion prototype.
author: MihYux

scripts.operator: npm run build && cross-env MARCH7TH_SURFACE=operator electron .
scripts.all: npm run build && cross-env MARCH7TH_SURFACE=all electron .
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test electron/ai-client.test.cjs electron/ai-settings.test.cjs electron/campaign-review.test.cjs electron/companion-store.test.cjs electron/contact-policy.test.cjs electron/content-safety.test.cjs electron/demo-scenarios.test.cjs electron/ipc-contract.test.cjs electron/prd-acceptance.test.cjs electron/release-system.test.cjs electron/release-skill-loader.test.cjs electron/layered-memory.test.cjs electron/release-constraints.test.cjs electron/release-workspace-store.test.cjs electron/release-workflow.test.cjs electron/plan-publish-workflow.test.cjs electron/plan-publish-draft.test.cjs electron/regional-plan-delivery.test.cjs electron/service-budget.test.cjs electron/tts-client.test.cjs electron/tts-settings.test.cjs electron/window-state.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit:acceptance && npm run audit:release
